rust_summary: level block outline and collision shapes.
doc_summary: Read a level's block-local outline or collision boxes with `level.block_shape(host, pos, kind)`. Shape reads resolve the level in place and parked levels. `level.block_face_sturdy(host, pos, face, support)` reads current or parked levels; false means not sturdy. It returns None for clients, stale or closed levels, unloaded or out-of-height positions, dynamic-shape states (including moving pistons and shulker boxes), or an exporter error. Dynamic support is a follow-up on #29. Bundles need "hooks": @API:level_shapes@.
